code: epi_cell_cap <- 12000L min_cells_pb <- 10L  set.seed(42) epi_cells <- obs_lung |>   dplyr::filter(cell_type_unified_ensemble == "epithelial") epi_cells <- dplyr::slice_sample(   epi_cells,   n = min(epi_cell_cap, nrow(epi_cells)) )  sce_epi <- epi_cells |>   get_single_cell_experiment(assays = "counts") |>   logNormCounts()  hvgs <- sce_epi |>   modelGeneVar() |>   getTopHVGs(n = 2000)  sce_epi <- sce_epi |>   runPCA(ncomponents = 30, subset_row = hvgs) |>   RunHarmony(     group.by.vars = "dataset_id",     dims.use = 1:30,     verbose = FALSE,     reduction.save = "HARMONY"   ) |>   runUMAP(dimred = "HARMONY", n_neighbors = 15)  sce_epi$epi_cluster <- factor(paste0(   "E",   clusterCells(     sce_epi,     use.dimred = "HARMONY",     BLUSPARAM = KmeansParam(centers = 6L)   ) )) # base::saveRDS(sce_epi, "./inst/extdata/sce_epi.rds", compress = "xz") sce_epi |>   ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = epi_cluster)) +   geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +   coord_equal() +   theme_bw()

se[, Matrix::colSums(SummarizedExperiment::assay(se, "counts")) > 0]     cd <- droplevels(as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(se)))     mm <- try(stats::model.matrix(de_design, data = cd), silent = TRUE)     !inherits(mm, "try-error") && qr(mm)$rank == ncol(mm)   },   logical(1) )  epi_cluster_screen <- epi_cluster_screen |>   dplyr::mutate(     frac_young = n_cells_young / pmax(n_cells, 1),     frac_old = n_cells_old / pmax(n_cells, 1),     eligible =       n_cells_young >= min_cells_per_class &       n_cells_old >= min_cells_per_class &       n_samples_young >= (!any(epi_cluster_screen$eligible)) {   stop(     "No epithelial cluster can support this design.
